---
name: 💡 Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement for WiFi Monitor
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: ["enhancement", "needs-triage"]
assignees: []
---

## 💡 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 🎯 Problem It Solves

What problem does this feature solve? Who benefits from it?

**Example**: "As a network administrator, I want to see historical signal trends per SSID so I can compare access points over time."

## 🔧 Proposed Solution

Describe your proposed solution or API. Include mockups or wireframes if you have them.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

What alternative approaches did you consider? Why is your proposal better?

## 📋 Acceptance Criteria

What would "done" look like for this feature?

- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Criterion 3

## 🌍 Additional Context

Any other context, screenshots, or references to similar features in other tools.

## 🤝 Willing to Help?

- [ ] I'd like to implement this myself (please assign the issue to me)
- [ ] I can help test this feature
- [ ] I can help write documentation for this feature
